primary: crowding_unwind: custom conjunction of historically extreme positioning, a four-report unwind, and confirming twenty-session price return
known_dates: At least seven calendar days after report date and one day after vendor release_date. Vendor release dates are not reliable during historical interruptions: reports dated2018-12-18 through2019-03-05 and2023-01-24 through2023-03-14 delayed60calendar days. No using created_at snapshot date as historical availability. These buffers are conservative approximations, not certified vintage data.
signal: Net noncommercial long-minus-short divided by OI. Z-score against prior52weekly reports (min40). Four-report change in that ratio. Primary long if z<-1, change>0 and20-session price return>0; short if z>1, change<0 and20-session price return<0. Strength=abs(z) clipped1to3. No optimizing thresholds or horizons.

controls.positioning_only: same crowding-and-unwind rule without price confirmation

sizing: Weekly first-session close decisions, next-open fills. Across active assets, weight proportional to strength/trailing63dayvol; normalize to2gross, clip each weight to50percent. Reduce to10percent forecast portfolio volatility using trailing63day covariance with at least40complete observations; never scale up beyond2gross. Full changes pay costs. Only final instructions control sizing, no optimized asset weights.
accounting: Use explicit cash, shares, daily marked short collateral and financing from research.share_class.simulate; free cash earns FrenchRF, debt financed at RF+1percent. No unrealized P&L omitted. Final liquidation costs included. All-asset adjusted ETF prices proxy total returns; derivative exposure occurs through these ETFs, not fabricated futures P&L.
target: Primary evaluation excess Sharpe>=2 and CAGR>10percent; positive stress excess mean; positive full-year2021-2024excess means; centered20daybootstrap one-sided p<.05. Controls never substitute for failed primary. Paired bootstrap against price-only control is descriptive.
limitations: Original combination does not establish global novelty
Previously observed market history; exploratory evaluation, not pristine holdout
COT snapshot revisions and conservative availability buffers
ETF mapping introduces basis mismatch versus reported futures
Broker borrow availability, variable borrow rates, ticket minimums, taxes and market impact not verified
No live orders or production changes
